EC1: - Diagnosis of 'medically unexplained symptoms' including somatoform disorders (e.g. pain disorder, [OR] conversion disorder, [OR] body dysmorphic disorder, [OR] hypochondriasis) and functional somatic syndromes (e.g. irritable bowel syndrome, [OR] chronic fatigue syndrome, [OR] fibromyalgia, non-cardiac chest pain, [OR] non-epileptic seizures)
EC2: - Mental health [OR] diagnoses in addition to anxiety [OR] or depression (e.g. personality disorder, [OR] bipolar disorder [OR] or psychosis)
EC3: - Currently accesses secondary care mental health services
EC6: - Previous contact with mental health services (defined as two or more prior episodes of service contact [NOT] without significant change)
EC7: - Inpatient admission for mental health difficulties within the last five years
EC9: - A stated [NOT] reluctance to engage in psychotherapy.
